title: Security fixes and tidier branch menus
summary: A security pass (AI review command, GitLab token, links from forges, dependencies) and branch menus that stay inside the window.

improvements.title: Branch menus stay inside the window
improvements.body: Submenus open on the side with room, and long branch names are cut in the middle with the full name in a tooltip, so "Merge 'a' into 'b'" keeps both names readable.

improvements.title: Checksums with each release
improvements.body: Releases now ship a SHA256SUMS.txt for the dmg and the installer.

fixes.title: AI review can't run code from a PR title
fixes.body: PR title, branch, base and URL are sanitised before going into the AI review command, so a crafted title can no longer run shell commands.

fixes.title: GitLab token only sent to your servers
fixes.body: The GitLab token is sent to gitlab.com and the servers listed in Settings only, no longer to any gitlab.* host.

fixes.title: Only web links are opened
fixes.body: PR links and notification clicks open only http(s) URLs, never file: or custom schemes.

fixes.title: Settings file readable by you only
fixes.body: settings.json, which holds tokens, is written with owner-only permissions.

fixes.title: Dependency security updates
fixes.body: rustls, rustls-webpki, webpki-roots and quinn-proto updated; cargo audit reports no vulnerabilities.
